title: Add a zero-dependency OpenAI-to-Groq migration smoke check
technicalRelationship: Groq exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, and AgentsKit's Groq adapter consumes that same protocol.
userValue: JavaScript developers can verify request compatibility, streaming, authentication, and model selection before migrating an application to Groq.

reproducedSetup.observed: The offline test verifies the OpenAI-compatible request and SSE response contract without contacting Groq; the live command remains optional.

utilityWithoutPromo.statement: The script depends only on Node.js fetch and Groq's documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

targetVoice: Neutral, practical, concise, and executable. Explain the protocol seam without framework promotion.
